guard.title: This view has stopped
guard.lede: Something went wrong while showing this part. Try again — and if the error comes back, pass on the message below.

unlock.kept: The key is computed from the password. It will be kept — sealed with this device's key, which the service doesn't know — so we won't ask for it again after a restart.
unlock.memory: The key is computed from the password and stays only in memory — after closing all tabs it has to be computed again.

signIn.needBoth: Enter the account name and password.
signIn.noKeys: The keys are not available in this tab.
signIn.noRole: The account has no role yet.
signIn.personFailedWhy: The account was created, but the person could not be created: {why}
signIn.personFailed: The account was created, but the person could not be created. Finish it in the „Roles" tab — click „Account".
signIn.ledeIn: Your workspace: groups, forms, calendar and chats.
signIn.ledeNew: The account is yours — only you hold its key.
signIn.name: Your name
signIn.nameHint: Only those you give access see the name. You can delete the account yourself at any time.
signIn.passwordStays: The password never leaves this device.
signIn.keysTakeTime: Encryption keys are being created — this takes a dozen seconds or so. Don't close the page.

frame.cutTitle: The service is not responding. Offline, learning from this device works.
